scheme.name: CO2-afgift on gas and diesel oil

dataset.method: CO2-afgiftsloven (lov om kuldioxidafgift af visse energiprodukter) § 2, stk. 1: the CO2 tax on gas and diesel oil, 188.9 øre per litre at day temperature in 2015 prices, indexed with the net price index (stk. 7): 226.1 øre per litre in 2025 (224.8 øre at 15 °C), as Skatteministeriet's rate table gives it. The supplier pays it on the fuel it sells and passes it on in the pump price, so a trip pays it where its fuel is bought. This is the rate for fossil diesel; diesel blended with 6.8 or 7.6% biofuel pays a little less per litre of blend. Litres are the trip's road fuel as given (diesel_l), or its tank-to-wheel CO2 at 2.67 kg per litre of diesel (EN 16258:2012).

sources.title: Skatteministeriet: rates in CO2-afgiftsloven for 2024 and 2025 (the Internet Archive's copy of July 2025)

tax.note: carbon-cost states the tax basis in each table's text (dataset.method), not as a field.
